跨國鎮壓 / Transnational Repression

Tier E event record. The community is a party to this: people of Taiwanese and Hong Kong origin living in the United States, Canada and Europe are surveilled, coerced, or attacked on behalf of the PRC state. This page is not commentary on the news — it is the archive’s own record of a pattern we have documented since 2021, assembled from our own holdings so that any future story lands on a spine we already have.

SUBSET check — the honest one (t_9ac13c5b / t_3c56174f rule): the 報告 limbs are zero-new; the roll-call limb is new to this kernel. Already recorded verbatim at t_56932582 / t_13f6b66b / t_9ac13c5b / t_5872995f: 政府已啟動修法程序、研議擴充《反滲透法》等法規防制範疇、針對受「境外敵對勢力」指示委託資助在台從事跟監騷擾威脅或暴力攻擊等危害個人自由與人身安全行為予以處罰或加重罰則以強化嚇阻; 立院司法及法制委員會 11-05 邀 法務部長、陸委會主委、司法院、外交部、內政部、國安局 就「跨境鎮壓對我國民主法治及人民基本權利之侵害與法律防制機制」專題報告並備質詢; 現行多以《刑法》傷害恐嚇、《組織犯罪防制條例》、《個人資料保護法》起訴、刑度較輕、嚇阻效果有限、缺乏追究「國家級幕後主導者與境外指揮者」之法律工具、更無法凸顯對民主法治、民眾安全及言論自由之實質危害; 美英加德已陸續通過或推動立法為跨國鎮壓或外國勢力干預訂立明確法律定義、針對受外國政府指使在境內對該國民眾或停居留外籍人士進行網路騷擾、名譽損害、經濟損失、跟監或暴力威脅者視為刑事犯罪或建立刑事加重處罰機制; 國安情報團隊與檢察機關已建立專案協作機制、加強蒐報預警情訊、保護潛在受害者安全、溯源中共境外指使者身分／跨境金流管道／在台犯罪網絡、完善事證查察及安維管控; 個別案況蒐獲危安預警情資即加強安維部署與查緝規劃、緝捕預謀加害者; 強化邊境安全管理、清查黑幫及不肖徵信業者之涉中關連、瓦解中共在台協力網絡. The foreign-comparative limb is present here in its NAMED form (美國 2025《跨國鎮壓政策法案》Transnational Repression Policy Act、2026《停止跨國鎮壓法案》The Stop Transnational Repression Act 均未完成立法；英國 2023《國家安全法》National Security Act 2023 引入《外國干預罪》、將協助外國情報機關及未登記之政治影響力活動入罪；加拿大 2024《反外國干預法》Countering Foreign Interference Act；德國今年新增《刑法》第 87a 條、受託在德違法者執行者與下令者均受刑事處罰) — carried as 報導, the 國安局報告’s own comparatives, not verified here against US Congress or Bundesgesetzblatt. Substance retained, all of it the institute’s and the papers’ as reported: (1) 民眾對使用金融商品或服務的信心從 2024 年的 38.9% 大幅提升至 64.1%（51.4% 還算有信心 + 12.7% 非常有信心，朱漢崙 surface 記為 64%）; (2) 支應日常生活開銷 86.5% 感到寬裕或得以支應（2 年前 74.6%，歷年新高），仍有約 10% 因 K 型經濟認為有支應困難; (3) 緊急預備金：51.6% 有足以維持至少半年生活基本開銷的存款緩衝、10.7% 有 3 至 6 個月，即約三分之二有 3 個月以上緩衝; (4) the headline limb — 急需大額用錢時的籌錢管道，過去以「自己儲蓄、家庭及朋友」的人際安全網為主，本次個人儲蓄及家庭友人籌資占比下降至 72%，而變賣股票和基金、保單借款、銀行貸款分別較去年增加 3.8%、5.2%、10.6%，金研院因此建議個人儲蓄仍應至少保留三個月以上生活費用的現金、不宜過度依賴槓桿; (5) 理財建議來源轉移 — 理專等銀行管道從 2 年前的 24% 降至 11%，投顧老師從 12.9% 增至 22.9%，社群／網紅比率上升; (6) 防詐信心從 65.7% 增至 73.8%，連動 打詐儀表板 報案件數（2025 年 19.7 萬件、今年前 9 月 11.9 萬件，紙上轉述）; (7) 高齡與虛擬資產落差 — 70 歲以上族群在電子支付與防詐信心上呈現高齡金融弱勢；政府今年 6 月底推動虛擬資產專法後，聽過加密貨幣者達 7 成 6、表示了解的只有 2 成，近 7 成不願持有虛擬資產; (8) 宏觀背景 — 2025 年家庭金融資產全數成長 8.7%、每戶可支配所得突破 100 萬（每人約 36 萬）、消費成長超過 5%，AI 與半導體需求帶動台股屢創新高; (9) the sibling limb — 9 月新開戶創新高（+6.5 萬人）、30 歲以下新開戶 4.1 萬戶占 6 成 3，大學生因 FOMO 進場並把定期定額視為儲蓄，金研院院長高一誠稱已與台大、政大、輔大、中原、中山、中正、逢甲、成大、東華等近十家大專院校合作開設每學期 1 學分的股匯投資金融教育課程，並提及明年 TISA 政策與集保等公司合作設計教材. (2) the early session fell 812.73 points to the day’s low on Friday’s −2.86% Nasdaq and −7.20% Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (the sibling CNA piece attributes the bulk of the US losses to weaker-than-expected Intel guidance); (3) bargain hunters lifted laggards — MediaTek +1.40% to NT$3,970.00 (low 3,795.00), Hon Hai Precision Industry +2.24% to NT$251.00 (low 242.50), Delta Electronics +1.50% to NT$1,355.00, Nanya Technology +0.44% to NT$456.50 (low 424.50); (4) TSMC failed to close positive, −1.69% to NT$2,330.00 after its ADR fell 5.95% Friday; (5) a crude-oil spike lifted petrochemicals — Formosa Petrochemical +4.78% to NT$103.00, Nan Ya Plastics +1.69% to NT$301.00, Formosa Plastics +0.83% to NT$73.10, Formosa Chemicals & Fibre +1.52% to NT$73.60; (6) grid-investment names outperformed — Fortune Electric +0.73% to NT$555.00, Chung-Hsin Electric & Machinery +0.65% to NT$154.00; (7) financials lagged — Fubon Financial Holding −1.24% to NT$159.50, CTBC Financial Holding −1.06% to NT$75.00; (8) the single quoted voice is 華南證券 (Hua Nan Securities) analyst Kevin Su, credited for the bargain-hunting read, the Samsung/SK Hynix rally in Seoul, the oil read, and two opinions carried as his: that the day’s buying of large tech 「came from government-led funds, instead of foreign investors, to bolster investor confidence」 amid a weakening Taiwan dollar, and that the lower turnover showed 「caution about the U.S. midterm elections scheduled for Tuesday」; (9) per the Taiwan Stock Exchange, foreign institutional investors net sold NT$73.52 billion on the main board Monday; (10) the sibling NDC piece has 葉俊顯 judging the AI-capex sell-off short-term only — 台廠 export orders accumulating through end-2027, no deterioration in liquidity or cash flow, fundamentals of the hardware suppliers intact. Labeling: 「off lows」「volatility」「bargain hunters」「market laggards」 are CNA’s market-desk framings; Kevin Su’s government-led-funds line is his own 「I suspect」 speculation carried as quoted opinion, not an established flow finding, and his midterm-caution line is likewise his inference; the NDC 主委’s 「only short-term impact」 is a government stakeholder’s assessment of its own产业, not a verified finding; every price, index and turnover figure above is CNA’s as reported and was not independently re-derived by this archive.

Form is the finding: this is a think-tank policy issue brief / advocacy piece — one author’s personal opinion, self-labelled as such («This analysis reflects his personal opinion») — not reportage of an event and not a community event; every figure in it is the author’s own or the MOEA’s as he reports it, and the recommendations are his. The Google wire redirect again returned 「Content was inaccessible or not found」 to web_extract and the wire id base64-decodes only to the opaque AU_yqL… token (the t_88e678ef read-text rule); the full body was read this run from the search-served canonical Atlantic Council text. Substance retained, all of it Webster’s / the Atlantic Council’s as reported: (1) the thesis — Beijing is laying the groundwork for an energy quarantine of Taiwan, and the risk could peak in 2028–2029 on economic, political, technical and military grounds (both Taiwan and the US hold key elections in 2028; Taiwan’s electricity reserve margin is on track to reach dangerously low levels in that period; US readiness may be degraded by protracted other-theater deployments; Xi’s age and a possible US AI takeoff window); (2) the mechanism limb — a quarantine lets some ships through and turns back others, especially oil tankers and LNG carriers, allowing Beijing to claim a domestic law-enforcement measure rather than an act of war; the PRC coast guard’s continuous presence east of Taiwan and its interdictions of live commercial traffic are read by the author as rehearsal; (3) the exposure limb — Taiwan has virtually no indigenous oil/gas/coal and is almost totally reliant on seaborne hydrocarbon imports; indigenous energy production (incl. nuclear) fell from 8.3% to 5.3% of demand 2016→2025; statutory reserve floors are oil 90 days / coal 30 / LNG 11, and the MOEA reported on-hand inventories of 150 / 40 / 11 days in March 2026 (author’s own figures, not re-derived here); (4) the timing limb — China’s oil security (electrification of transport fuel, domestic crude, overland pipeline imports largely from Russia, refinery maximization, large petroleum stockpiles) lets it decouple from international markets and act more aggressively, while a quarantine would rely on supply flows rather than stock withdrawals; the US 「implicit answer」 — a counter-blockade of China’s oil imports — is judged increasingly outdated; (5) the two scenarios — a direct coast-guard interdiction under a legal pretext, or an indirect route exploiting/stimulating a Middle East oil crisis that disproportionately hurts import-dependent rivals while China becomes a 「self-sufficient electrotech state」; (6) the recommendation limb — an all-of-the-above generation mix plus transmission hardening; expand nuclear and restart the third plant at Maanshan in 2028 (reactors unlikely to be deliberately struck because Beijing does not want radiation on the island it seeks to seize); deepen ties with the US LNG complex and expand gas storage; and the headline plan — a 「north diesel, south renewables」 posture: northern Taiwan is a net importer of 「南電北送」 power, Taipei’s solar capacity factor is 「about the same as Seattle’s」, onshore land is minimal, offshore wind underperforms in peak summer months, and the Datan and Tunghsiao gas plants plus finite northern LNG mean Taipei could run out of electricity in under one month if south-to-north lines are cut; for ~US$10 billion capex + ~US$500 million/yr to maintain, test and rotate fuel, the north could field ~2 GW of diesel generation (author’s own calculation) — about half the capex for a dedicated diesel stockpile and dispersed hardened storage, the rest for generators — enough to keep hospitals, cooling stations, sanitation, telecom and emergency services running in the north for roughly five months without southern power; a first tranche stood up by summer 2027 with exercises during the Urban Resilience drills, full buildout across 2028–2029; the south/center keep existing thermal plants plus onshore solar/wind that are hard to interdict; (7) the US-role limb — US firms to engage across the diesel/LNG/nuclear/solar-storage supply chain, and the chief US contribution judged to be preventing sabotage of south-to-north transmission and energy infrastructure, with the author asserting CCP intelligence services would use cyber and kinetic means including connections with criminal networks, so the US should rotate far more energy, counternarcotics and countersabotage personnel through Taiwan drawing on DOE, DEA, FBI and other civilian agencies through AIT; (8) the leverage limb — China’s food vulnerability and its steel industry’s dependence on Australian iron ore, plus economic/financial leverage, with the author’s own figure that net exports contributed 32.7% of China’s GDP growth, the highest since 1997; and (9) the policy-posture limb — Washington should underscore continued commitment to the 「One China」 policy anchored to the Taiwan Relations Act, the three communiqués and the Six Assurances while warning Beijing against aggression. Labeling: 「energy quarantine」「laying the groundwork」「dangerous new reality」「self-sufficient electrotech state」「increasingly outdated」 are the author’s framings carried as reported; the 2028–2029 peak, the $10B/2 GW/5-month arithmetic and the sabotage read are his estimates and his inferences, not findings of this archive (his own 「based on author calculations」 hedge retained); the inventory and percentage figures are the MOEA’s and the sources’ as he cites them and were not independently re-derived here; 「could」「might」「likely」「unlikely」 hedges are his and are retained; 跨國鎮壓 appears nowhere in this copy and no individual other than the author is named in it.

(2) the procurement limb — Taiwan’s military 「wants to acquire more than 1,400 coastal surveillance and reconnaissance drones, over 200,000 coastal attack drones and 1,320 one-way attack uncrewed surface vessels (USVs)」, and parliament 「recently passed a NT$240 billion (US$7.4 billion) drone defence bill, with more spending expected to be approved this month」; Virginia USV maker STR8 Industries CEO Phil Ho on 「project scalable force」; Singapore UUV firm BeeX CEO Grace Chia on demand surging since Iran claimed control of the Strait of Hormuz; Lorien Dynamics, 「a division of US-based Strike Defense Group (SDG)」, displaying an underwater acoustic sensor; Bryce Barros, 「a former US Senate national security adviser and currently at the Global Taiwan Institute」, on USVs/UUVs complicating 「Chinese military operations and the calculus for it」 and on satellite communications mattering less inside Taiwan’s 12 nautical mile (22 kilometre) territorial zone; and Su Tzu-yun 「a military expert at the Taipei-based Institute for National Defense and Security Research」 on sea drones also addressing 「Taiwan’s manpower shortage caused by its declining birth rate」; (6) the cost/risk limb — a sea drone costs 「anywhere from thousands to millions of US dollars」 and takes weeks or months to build, versus years for a warship or submarine; analysts warn of integration, interoperability, and operating without access to Elon Musk’s Starlink satellites. The limbs this surface alone carries:

(5) 學術 limb — 「國立臺灣師範大學一篇碩士論文發現，『不會』與『不客氣』在台灣華語中各有適用對象，兩者並不能任意替換」; named as 師大華語文教學系研究生黃家安 in 指導教授 洪嘉馡 指導下, 論文《臺灣華語回應感謝之語用策略及教學建議》, 於2024年出版, 方法 「自然對話、口語語料庫及問卷調查」, 歸納出 四種策略與九種說法（「不用客氣」、「不客氣」、「哪裡」、「不會」、「沒事」、「謝謝」、「嗯」、「好」, plus 什麼都不說也沒有肢體動作的「零形式」）; 發現 「不客氣」較適合長輩對晚輩、「帶有回絕對方客套態度的意味」，「不會」用在平輩之間或晚輩回應長輩、「間接化解對方的虧欠感」，「謝謝」適用於雙方存在互惠關係的情境; 論文並點出 華語教材把回應感謝的方式過度簡化、易讓學習者誤以為一說通用 — 「正好呼應外國網友『課本和現實不一樣』的經驗」.

(6) 英語世界 limb — 「美國語言學家丁金 (Aaron Dinkin) 曾讓學生在多倫多街頭向路人問路並道謝，共收集 1537次回應，整體有 41%回「you’re welcome」、31%回「no problem」，且越年輕越傾向說「no problem」；年長者視「no problem」為較隨意、只適合回應簡短道謝，年輕人則無此限制，該語正從敷衍轉變為禮貌用語」; plus 「《今日心理學》 專欄也提到，『You’re welcome』如今可能被解讀成帶點諷刺或炫耀，與台灣網友覺得『不客氣』像在邀功的感受相當類似」.

(7) 中國網友 limb — 「台灣人愛說『不會』的習慣，連中國網友也印象深刻。聯合新聞網2024年曾報導，一名中國男網友在小紅書分享向台灣人道謝、對方回「不會」，他雖不解卻覺得十分可愛；留言區有人提到**周杰倫〈半島鐵盒〉**開頭的女店員回的就是「不會」，也有人說「不會」等於不用謝、相當於台語的「免客氣」」. Attribution is the paper’s own — 「翻攝畫面」 with no link; the 聯合新聞網 2024 piece is not linked and not verified by this archive.

Reported. 2026-10-30 — 跨國鎮壓真相曝! 旅義維權人士遭跟監 義國起訴4名嫌犯 — 民視新聞網 (wire, canonical ftvnews.com.tw/news/detail/2026A29I26M1, 民視新聞／吳若望 綜合報導, 發佈 2026-10-30 06:37) — needs-tier t_26ee5866. The Google wire redirect again returned “Content was inaccessible or not found” to web_extract (the t_88e678ef read-text rule); the 民視 canonical was resolved by search and the body read in full, cross-checked line-by-line against the 中央社記者 黃雅詩／羅馬 29 日專電 twin (cna.com.tw/news/aopl/202610290350.aspx, also carried by 聯合新聞網 / 經濟日報 / 世界新聞網). Form matters for the ruling: this is the Italian-prosecution leg of the 10-27→10-30 跨國鎮壓 cycle — a 米蘭檢方 偵結 of a surveillance ring against a mainland-origin dissident resident in Italy — not a new repression event against our people. Substance retained, all of it the papers’ and the prosecution’s as reported: (1) 米蘭檢方 completed the investigation of 10 suspects who intimidated 「反對中國國家主席習近平政策的中國僑民」; 4 charged with 共謀犯罪 (an 「組織…長期從事鎮壓異議人士活動」), the other 6 charged with 長期參與跟監 (stalking since 2023); (2) target = the X account 「李老師不是你老師」, whose real owner is 李穎 (Li Ying), 34, a Chinese artist who came to Italy to study art, made known for uploading 清零-era protest footage and 白紙運動 material; surveillance was 「不僅僅為了蒐集其行蹤，更是為了阻止他繼續譴責中國政府的政策」, conducted between 米蘭 and 杜林; (3) main suspect 王松強 (Songqiang Wang), 57, 執行會長 of 米蘭福建華人協會, allegedly 「代表中國警方」行事, in close contact with 外交人員 and 中共中央統戰部 members, personally taking part in the tracking; (4) 趙建斌 — per LinkedIn and 華人街 official-site info, 總編輯 of the Italy-華人社區 site 「華人街」 — allegedly recruited 旅義中國公民 as watchers and ran the tasking via 微信 groups; (5) 劉振鋼 (titled 會長 of 義大利福建僑商聯合會 on 中國僑社 sites) allegedly acted on 北京警方 instruction and kept contact with 外交人員; (6) 李穎 applied for 政治庇護 2023-07, granted 2024-11, still followed, his parents in China harassed, he keeps changing residence; (7) context — Italy’s 內政部 issued 驅逐令 against 8 中國公民 suspected of monitoring/repressing dissidents in Italy, 2026-03. Reported. 2026-10-29 — Taiwan considers penalties for transnational repression: Cabinet — Focus Taiwan (CNA English) (wire, canonical focustaiwan.tw/politics/202610290015) — needs-tier t_0397cd52. Focus Taiwan / CNA English, bylined (By Sean Lin), 發布 10/29/2026 07:15 PM (Taipei), dateline 「Taipei, Oct. 29 (CNA)」. Body read in full this run — the Google wire redirect again returned “Content was inaccessible or not found” to web_extract and jina 403’d on news.google.com (the t_88e678ef read-text rule); the canonical Focus Taiwan URL was fetched directly and the full article body read, including the sibling inline link 「● Five indicted over staged collision involving comedian critical of Xi」. Form matters for the ruling: this is the Cabinet-legislative leg of the 10-27→10-29 跨國鎮壓 cycle — the Executive Yuan announcing it is considering amendments to the Anti-Infiltration Act — not a new repression event against our people. Substance retained, all of it the Cabinet’s and the paper’s as reported: (1) 內閣（政院）發言人 Michelle Lee（李慧芝） at the weekly Cabinet news conference: the government is considering legislation to penalize individuals who engage in 「transnational repression」 in Taiwan on behalf of an 「external hostile force」; (2) the instrument is amendments to the Anti-Infiltration Act（反滲透法） establishing penalties for such conduct; (3) conduct that could constitute offenses under the proposed amendments: surveillance, harassment and intimidation; (4) 「We will use clearer, more specific rules to protect public safety in the future」 and 「Once the required legal procedures are complete, we will submit the draft amendments to the Legislative Yuan as soon as possible」— both Lee’s quoted words; (5) the trigger named by the paper: a reporter’s question about attempts backed by the Chinese government to pressure people in Taiwan into making political statements; (6) the paper’s own named example — entertainer Kevin Tsai（蔡康永） recently posted apologies on Weibo and RedNote (Xiaohongshu) after appearing at an event marking the opening of the campaign headquarters for Puma Shen（沈伯洋）, the DPP’s Taipei mayoral candidate; Tsai wrote 「I have always hoped that the two sides of the [Taiwan] Strait can interact amicably. I have never supported Taiwan independence」 and apologized to business partners and fans he may have disappointed; many in Taiwan interpreted the posts as apologies made under pressure from China; Tsai has not commented on whether he made the posts under duress (the paper’s own hedge, carried as its labeling); (7) the paper’s context lines: Shen is an expert on China’s cognitive warfare and disinformation campaigns and is among 14 individuals, most DPP-affiliated, whom the CCP has designated 「die-hard Taiwan independence separatists」; and the 2016 comparison case — Taiwanese K-pop idol Chou Tzu-yu（周子瑜） of Twice issued a recorded apology after briefly waving Taiwanese and South Korean flags on a South Korean TV show, saying she was 「proud to be Chinese」. Labeling: 「transnational repression」「external hostile force」「pressure people in Taiwan into making political statements」are the Cabinet’s and the paper’s framings carried as reported; 「many in Taiwan interpreted Tsai’s posts as apologies made under pressure」is the paper’s characterization of public reading, not a finding, and the paper itself records that Tsai never said he acted under duress; the 「die-hard」 designation is the CCP’s. Nothing here is a finding of fact by this archive.

Reported. 2026-10-27 — 加拿大跨黨派議員支持立法 打擊跨國鎮壓 | 大紀元 (wire) — needs-tier t_b653fca8. 大紀元記者 梁耀 採訪報導，【大紀元2026年10月28日訊】，更新 2026-10-28 7:44 AM，canonical epochtimes.com/b5/26/10/27/n14877969.htm，標籤 跨國鎮壓 / C-219法案 / 加拿大，責任編輯 田青. Body read in full this run in-browser from the live canonical URL (web_extract on the Google wire redirect returned “Content was inaccessible or not found” — the t_88e678ef read-text rule; the redirect resolved fine in-browser). Form matters for the ruling: this is the Canadian legislative-progress + cross-party-endorsement leg of the C-219 cycle already on this spine, not a new repression event against our people. Substance retained, all of it the paper’s and the quoted MPs’ as reported: (1) C-219《國際反腐敗與人權法案》（亦稱《謝爾蓋·馬格尼茨基法第三號》）is Canada’s first law to write 「跨國鎮壓」 and 「良心犯」 into statute; passed 眾議院 and is now in 參議院二讀; (2) sponsor James Bezan 貝贊（保守黨，影子國防部長，2025-09-16 提出）三讀辯論 2026-10-08: the bill renames 《腐敗外國官員受害者正義法》→《謝爾蓋·馬格尼茨基法》、《特別經濟措施法》→《全球制裁與特別經濟措施法》（第二號）, first defines 良心犯 and 跨國鎮壓 in Canadian law, requires 外交部長 annual 國會報告 on 人權捍衛者/良心犯 work, raises 規避制裁罰款上限 to $100,000, and sets a 24-month timetable for confiscation of sanctioned persons’ Canadian assets, proceeds distributable to victims or government; (3) Bezan names 法輪功學員 as victims of 騷擾、威脅、襲擊及活摘器官 — he says he received a letter the week before the debate from a 多倫多法輪功修煉者 assaulted and death-threatened while protesting peacefully outside the 中共領事館, argues the attackers may hide behind 外交豁免權 and 「必須為此接受審判」; answering Ziad Aboultaif 齊亞德·阿布勒泰夫（保守黨）he said the 法輪功 group 「受到迫害和殺害，其器官被非法摘取並出售到世界各地」; answering Mario Beaulieu 馬里奧·博利厄（魁人政團）he cited evidence of 醫生 and others trading in victims’ 心臟、肺、肝、腎（「一種令人作嘔的行為」）and criticized 中共對維吾爾人 實施「再教育」、絕育及強迫勞動; he calls the amended bill less comprehensive than the original but 「對於未來現代化加拿大制裁機制至關重要」, and urges an 國際反腐敗法院; (4) Bezan names 壹傳媒創辦人 黎智英 as the typical 良心犯（「他是一名良心犯，我們必須營救他」，per Bezan 已判終身監禁）, and alleges 北京 has 警察站 in Canada and 至少干預過兩次選舉; (5) cross-party endorsements: 自由黨資深議員 Judy Sgro 思格若（10-20 對大紀元：「真正開始讓這些法律長出牙齒 put some teeth in these laws」）、外交部長國會祕書 Mona Fortier 莫娜·福捷（「提高透明度，並使加拿大的制裁制度現代化」；委員會修訂使年度人權報告不再公開列名個別良心犯以贯彻「不造成傷害」原則）、Chi Nguyen 阮芝（「加強加拿大的制裁制度，並更新人權框架」，選區居民關注海外親友所受政治鎮壓與任意拘留）、Sameer Zuberi 薩米爾·祖貝里（委員會曾聽取 藏人、維吾爾人、法輪功修煉者、香港人及受伊朗、俄羅斯鎮壓者證詞）、魁人政團 博利厄（支持擴大制裁、限制受制裁者家屬簽證、RCMP–FINTRAC 合作及資產沒收）. Labeling: 「跨國鎮壓」「良心犯」「活摘」「警察站」「干預兩次選舉」「再教育、絕育及強迫勞動」are Bezan’s and the paper’s framings carried as reported; the 多倫多領館外襲擊信 is Bezan’s account of a letter he received (no police charge or court finding named in this copy); the 黎智英 終身監禁 characterization is Bezan’s/the paper’s; nothing here is a finding of fact by this archive.

Substance retained, all of it the quoted 知情官員’s as reported: (1) 北檢已起訴 4 名台嫌、對港籍僱主 鞠覺賢、林慶 發布通緝，二港人「未在台灣設籍」，未來若有在台港人配合中共跨境鎮壓，「已經入籍的，會註銷其台灣身分，還在居留階段，不會讓他們定居」— the 廢止居留定居 policy signal is the only new content in this copy; (2) 「這二名港人並不是在台灣居留的港人，明顯有集團在背後跨國指揮」，委託的香港人才是重點，因為是跨境鎮壓的來源; (3) 台港司法互助幾乎停頓、港府不會交人，引渡有困難，故制度目標是「抓得到、判得重」，在出境前逮捕到案; (4) 法務部正研議修正《反滲透法》加重其刑，境外鎮壓犯罪不應再視為個人法益、須視為侵犯國家法益才能判重刑，否則現在都是違反個資法等輕罪; (5) 對照例：印太戰略智庫執行長 矢板明夫 在台中遭暴力攻擊、行兇者也是香港人、檢方起訴五年（「揍一拳就5年」，不再視為單純傷害案），以及「中共派女房仲在美國跟拍、蒐集賴總統家人的資訊，在美國這種罪判很重」。Labeling: every characterization above is the anonymous 知情官員’s (unnamed, so no actor row — t_c143aa9a precedent); 起訴 remains allegation (未判決、推定無罪), 通緝 is a prosecutorial measure not a finding; 「境外敵對勢力」「跨國指揮」「有集團在背後」are the official’s framing carried by the paper, and our own 安保協會 record still notes 未證實 港籍委託人與中國官方機關間的具體指揮關係. Nothing in this copy is a finding of fact by this archive.

Reported. 2026-10-13 — 《國有器官》在台放映屢遭恐嚇 陸委會：不容境外勢力剝奪民眾知情權 大紀元 (wire) — 大紀元記者戴德蔓 2026-10-13. Same event as the LTN wire above. The Canadian documentary《國有器官》, which exposes PRC forced organ harvesting through testimony of practitioners and victims’ families, drew bomb, gunshot and cyber threats against multiple Taiwan cinemas and related organizations during its run; on 10-08 陸委會 invited the production team — director 章勇進 (Raymond Zhang), producer 宋美馨 (Cindy Song), 台灣法輪大法學會理事長 蕭松山, 新唐人記者 張東旭 — with 法政處長 周鳴瑞 receiving, to 關心 the intimidation and interference they faced. 周鳴瑞 framed the pattern as 跨國鎮壓: threats against screening venues and interference with distribution are aimed not only at individuals but at the public’s right to know. 宋美馨 said the pressure shows Beijing trying to “把這個 黑手伸進台灣”; the team thanked 警方 and government units for safety support during the screenings. Tier D for the named subjects — 章勇進/宋美馨/蕭松山/張東旭/周鳴瑞 have no relationship or presence in our archive (grep of content/ returns no person or org pages), so no pages minted; the community is not a named party in this item, the theme is ours. Ruling consistent with needs-tier t_45219d6b. The archive does hold the shape this event repeats: 2025-06-23 — 立法院外交及國防委員會邀請國安局、文化部、 警政署、陸委會報告「從『國有器官』在台播映困境看中國對台灣的長臂管轄策略，及我國的因應方案」 (陸委會：中國來台交流人士經過精心挑選), so the pattern is ours on file, not this year’s headline.

Body read in full. Substance: the author recounts overcoming his own CCP-instilled fear of 法輪功. He names two U.S.-based Chinese friends who recoiled when he said he was writing about 法輪功 — 陳強（化名）, a ten-year acquaintance who asked 「你還能跟大陸做生意嗎？你還有自由嗎？」, and an unnamed 河南 friend in the U.S. who fell silent and kept his distance. This copy is the 【禁聞】 TV wrap: the database core is restated, not advanced (《涉政落查人員庫》 from the PRC 政法系統, 24,170 records / ~10,000+ people after dedup, 大紀元 itself states it cannot independently verify overall accuracy; overseas-platform accounts on X / Facebook / 大紀元 / 新唐人 / 文學城 resolved to real name, ID, address, work unit and family; ~22,500 records (93%) carry a mainland location and of the ~10,500 with a domestic residence, 4,783 are pinned to a door-address, with the reporting’s own caveat that a China address may be pre-departure or a family address). What is new in this copy is not the database but the two interview blocks and one piece of colour: 界立建 (called 「中國民主黨國際聯盟主席」 here) says 「一萬多人的統計數據，只少不多」, that 大數據 monitoring now sweeps 民運領袖、活動參與者、自媒體網紅 and 「意識形態能帶給大家覺醒的倡導者」, that the 「海外反賊名單」 and 「漢奸展覽館」 sites look 民間牽頭 but their 技術、網路支持、經費資金 are 「背後肯定是中共國家安全部去統一撥款」, that 納粹 and 恐怖分子 alike observe 「禍不及家人」 whereas this practice 「株連、軟禁受害者國內的親人」 makes it 「跨國恐怖犯罪」 deserving 馬格尼茨基 accountability — and the item reports that he has submitted evidence of CCP 跨國迫害 to the FBI and to Congress. 盛雪 (called 「民主陣線副主席」 here) gives the 統戰-system framing: the apparatus predates the PRC, its core method is 鎖定目標人物 and collecting all their information so that 軟肋、日常生活、關係網、朋友、家人 become 「打擊對手的槓桿」; it grew 「更加激進蠻橫」 after 習近平 took office, seeding 線人 across sectors; and the 退出黨團隊 campaign is a way to remove the system’s 著力點. The item also attributes to her 偽造色情圖片, 冒名發布炸彈威脅 and 連坐 persecution of her mainland relatives. Every characterization above is the speaker’s, attributed: no indictment, filing, or court finding is cited, and nothing here is recorded as established fact. Reported. 2026-10-23 — Suspected Chinese spy pleads not guilty to targeting Taiwan leader’s kin wire (INQUIRER.net US Bureau) — needs-tier t_356d22dc. The 7th triage of ONE case on this spine — United States v. Wanying Zhang, aka “Heather” (18 U.S.C. § 951), already carried under t_83a964c2 (2026-10-14), t_7979cbe0 (10-17), t_bca025f2 + t_35ee8f07 (10-19), t_2a804da6 (10-20), t_928b9374 (10-20). The Google News redirect is inaccessible (t_88e678ef read-text rule), and INQUI’s own URL served a Cloudflare interstitial (Just a moment..., 5.8 KB) while The Online Citizen 403’d, so the body was read in full from CBS News (Josh Boswell, CBS News Investigative Unit, 2026-10-23 5:15 PM EDT, cbsnews.com/news/wanying-zhang-alleged-chinese-agent-pleads-not-guilty/) and NBC Los Angeles (Helen Jeong, Danielle Smith & AP, 2026-10-23, nbclosangeles.com/news/local/irvine-spy-china-fbi-lax/3960062/), which carry the same event and the same quotes as the INQUI wire. Ruling made on read text, not on the wire headline. What this filing advances is the court posture, and only the court posture: Zhang pleaded not guilty on Friday 2026-10-23 at the post-indictment arraignment in federal court in downtown Los Angeles — the step our pages carried as scheduled, now held. She appeared in a white jumpsuit and shackles, speaking only to deny the charges. The judge set a pretrial hearing for 2026-11-12 and trial to begin 2026-11-30 at the federal courthouse in Santa Ana, estimated to last four days — dates that were not in the archive before this filing. Both prosecutors and defense counsel Craig Harbaugh declined to comment. Husband Edric Ding (realtor at the same Irvine firm) had appeared at earlier hearings and did not appear Friday, after prosecutors claimed in a recent filing that Zhang was having an affair with the man who accompanied her on the alleged Washington-state surveillance; CBS again names him as Fatai Miao, not charged, who left Southern California on a one-way ticket to China, and whose son denies any wrongdoing. NBC/AP add the Presidential Office statement attributed by name to spokesperson Karen Kuo (「a classic case of transnational repression」, 「Taiwan condemns in the strongest terms such barbaric acts…」) and the Chinese Foreign Ministry’s reply (not aware of the incident; opposes 「hyped-up accusations of ‘China spying’」). Labeling unchanged: indictment = allegation, no finding of fact, defendant presumed innocent until proven guilty (推定無罪); every characterization above is the speaker’s own, attributed.

Reported. 2026-10-22 — 中國民主黨國際聯盟揭中共20多宗跨國鎮壓 大紀元 (wire) — 大紀元記者陶若水紐約報導 2026-10-22 09:24 AM, n14874264, 責任編輯 鄭樺. This is NOT a sibling of the 《涉政落查人員庫》 cluster already on this spine under t_e58ab73c / t_8dbfccc6 / t_c53fb57f: that story is the leaked 24,170-record database; this one is a street action — 中國民主黨國際聯盟 (CDPIA) held a rally on 2026-10-18 in front of the Queens Library in Flushing (王后區法拉盛圖書館前), a 華人-concentrated public venue, with display boards showing photographs of Chinese police visiting members’ families, footage of the assault on 民運人士 at the earlier Washington protest, and phone/微信 threat recordings played over a loudspeaker to passers-by.

What the item alleges (all attributed; no finding of fact). 主席 界立建 says that around the September 2026 visit to the U.S. by 習近平 and the organization’s Washington protest, the alliance holds evidence of 20+ cases of intimidation, threats and harassment against members and their families; some were threatened before departure, gave up protesting, and were harassed anyway. Named first-person accounts: 徐其仁 (江西) supplied a call recording in which local 國保 personnel, having taken his mother to a 中共社區機構 and phoning him in front of her, said they knew of his CDPIA membership and his dealings with 界立建, demanded he withdraw, referenced his pregnant wife, warned his mother could be implicated and that he faced imprisonment if he returned to China. 張劉敏 (河南鄭州) and 方碩 (江蘇) each received threat calls before the Washington trip — 張劉敏 threatened with her child’s safety — both stood down, were harassed regardless, and were told to leave the alliance and cut contact with 界立建 or 「後果自負」; 張劉敏 said she would not withdraw and would publicize the case and pursue legal accountability. 界立建 said the harassment is not confined to families in China: the alliance’s Malaysia web administrator 楊佳 was followed and threatened and dare not return to his residence, and members in Thailand feared rendition to China. Rally attendee 李中平 said Flushing was chosen precisely because it is 華人集中, and called on the U.S. government to investigate CCP agents operating illegally in the U.S. and to protect threatened people. 界立建 said the alliance is collecting names, recordings and video to submit to the U.S. government, Congress and international human-rights bodies under the Global Magnitsky Act, and urged targets to report and preserve evidence.

Tier ruling — Tier D for every named subject; no page minted. The CONTROL §1b discriminator is party status, and it returns Tier D here even though the venue is a U.S.-soil 華人 public space and the theme is genuinely ours: the people named as targets are members of a Chinese-dissident organization, their surveilled families are in mainland China (江西, 河南鄭州, 江蘇), and the two cross-border legs are Malaysia and Thailand — not 台美人 subjects, not families surveilled here. The U.S.-soil element in this item is the rally, not the repression. No 台美人 target, no action against any person or organization we record, no families-surveilled-here claim. Precedents: t_c53fb57f (界立建 as quoted interviewee), t_c0953057 / t_63ba370b (non-U.S.-soil legs of this theme), t_50d337d5 / t_c143aa9a (no pages for unnamed groups).

Why this belongs in Echopedia

Per CONTROL §1b, the Tier D↔E discriminator is whether the community is a party, not whether the story is famous. It is:

  • The targets are members of, or adjacent to, the diaspora we record — 台灣人 abroad, 僑界, Hong Kong residents in U.S. cities, and family members of public figures.
  • The operations occur on soil where our members live: Los Angeles, the San Gabriel Valley, Toronto, university towns across the U.S.
  • Our archive carried the evidence before the current cycle made it a headline.

Labeling standard: every claim below carries its status. Sourced = a document in this archive. Reported = press assertion we have not independently verified. Alleged = accusation in a filing or statement, recorded with attribution and without a finding of fact. Nothing is omitted for being uncomfortable; nothing is asserted beyond what the record holds.

2021 — “獵捕” of Taiwanese worldwide

Sourced. 強制送中，國際組織：中國在全世界「獵捕」台灣人 records international organizations’ finding that Taiwan nationals are pursued abroad. The framing is not “influence” but capture.

2022 — religious communities targeted under 天網 / 獵狐

Sourced. 中國通過”天網""獵狐”跨國鎮壓宗教團體成員 — the operation against religious-group members abroad, filed under the 天網/獵狐 framework; the archive’s own title records 美國際宗教自由委員會 naming 習近平 in its criticism.

2023 — the legislative response begins

Sourced. 美兩黨參議員提案打擊中國跨境鎮壓行動 — bipartisan Senate action, i.e. this is a recognized state-to-state problem, not an immigrant-community rumor.

Sourced. 加拿大警方稱已關閉與”中國警察站”有關的”非法警務活動” — Toronto. Physical police stations operated on Canadian soil.

Sourced. 「不支持言論自由，就別來上學」普渡大學校長公開信 — the campus vector: students harassing peers over political speech, with the pressure traced to PRC-aligned organizing.

2024 — sanctions as the countermeasure; retaliation against individuals

Sourced. 許穎婷推制裁法案觸怒港府 遭懸賞百萬通緝 — a legislator of our region facing a bounty. This is the community as a party in the most literal sense.

Sourced. 習近平訪美期間許多抗議人士被圍毆 — physical assault on protesters during a state visit; human-rights groups sought hearings.

2025 — the multilateral layer

Sourced. 跨國調查揭北京鎮壓滲透全球 聯合國淪中國打壓異己工具 — an investigative body of work, not one outlet’s account.

Sourced. 區域宗教自由論壇：台灣是中共遂行「再教育」下一目標

Sourced. 美國務院報告：中共戰狼及假帳號充斥網絡空間 — the information-operation layer that precedes and accompanies physical action.

Form matters for the ruling: this is a Japanese-paper investigative exclusive relayed by a Taiwanese outlet — a sanctions-evasion smuggling network story — not a 跨國鎮壓 event and not a community event. Substance retained, all of it 《讀賣新聞》‘s and the US prosecutors’ as reported: (1) 《讀賣新聞》 2026-11-02, citing multiple informed sources, exposes a civilian criminal ring using the free-trade port 香港 to move 軍火與違禁品 from the United States through Hong Kong to 北韓; (2) the Hong Kong leg is led by a 香港籍蔡姓男子, the beneficial operator of the consignee 「裕領貿易有限公司」, which received the US-origin cargo — after 北韓駐港總領事館 closed in 2023 he also won the contract to ship the repatriating diplomats’ household goods and used that cover to load the weapons together with the diplomats’ sea freight (the diplomats are said to have known nothing — 報導); (3) the 台籍王姓男子 — met 蔡男 in 2024 per ETtoday (聯合報 dates the ring’s vessel arrangement to 2023) — is the beneficial owner/operator of the cargo vessel 「向陽號」（Sunrich / SUN RICH）, then 塞拉利昂籍 (聯合報: 獅子山共和國 flag), now washed to 岡比亞籍「藍塔號」（Blue Tower） after repeated renaming and re-flagging; he was previously arrested for smuggling in China and currently resides in 南韓; (4) a third man, 梁姓 (聯合報: 中國籍), former used-car salesman and beneficial operator of 「天馬船務有限公司」, supplied ship-operations services and in 2024 laundered US$2 million（約新台幣6400萬元） of 北韓軍方 cash into virtual currency; (5) the ring also smuggled a top-tier 豪車 airlifted from the Middle East to North Korea, the same model 金正恩 was photographed riding in early-2024 official activities (ETtoday: 疑似; 讀賣’s own hedge retained); (6) modus: false destination 南韓仁川港 on HK customs filings, AIS switched off on the high sea in the 黃海 approaches, actual berth 北韓西部南浦港, entries timed Friday night / exits weekends to exploit loose HK weekend watch and transit-port non-inspection; 讀賣 reports the ring still operates 4 貨輪, recently moving UN-banned 鋼鐵 products and possibly planning 石油 smuggling from 馬來西亞; (7) verification limb — former UN Panel of Experts DPRK sanctions member 古川勝久, after comparing US criminal records against sources’ documents, judges the accounts to have a reasonably sufficient basis (讀賣’s attribution, not our finding); the Panel itself ceased operating end-April 2024 after Russia vetoed its extension; (8) the US leg, from our own primary sources: a 中國籍 man 文勝華（Shenghua Wen）, 42, of Ontario CA, arrested December 2024, pleaded guilty 2025-06-09 to one count of conspiracy to violate IEEPA (50 U.S.C. §1705) and one count of acting in the United States as an illegal agent of a foreign government (18 U.S.C. §951); sentenced 2025-08-18 by Judge Stephen V. Wilson to 96 months; per the plea agreement he met DPRK officials at a North Korean embassy in China before entering the US, was tasked in 2022 by officials 「Jin Yong Nan」and 「Cui」 over Wickr, bought the Texas FFL AK5000 INC (Super Armory) with DPRK-sent money, shipped ≥3 containers of firearms out of 長灘港（Long Beach） in 2023, and the 2023-12-04 shipment falsely declared as 「a refrigerator」 (container OEH-20154, vessel ONE IBIS 0031W) reached Hong Kong ~2024-01-01 and was then transported to Nampo, North Korea; DPRK officials wired him ~US$2M.
